text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: WOOHOOOOO! The Fan Fest is here! LEEET'S GOOO!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: This is the day of sweet forbidden reversals, where rules are tossed out! Today, Umamusume support the fans, like me! I don't know if my heart —Gwafassdfh!
choice_data_list: Now hold on just a second!
Now hold on just a second!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What is it? I'm pretty busy today…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Um… Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?! No one told me that! But I wanna forget about the Twinkle Series for a day and enjoy myself as a simple fan…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Who could possibly benefit from seeing me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I drag a griping Agnes Digital to the autograph booth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Th-there's quite a few people in my line too… Wh-wh-what kind of weirdos are they?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Maybe they've mistaken my line for someone else's? Like, I don't have a drop of anything like Creek's motherly charm in me, no matter how hard you squeeze…)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Agh, the first person in line is coming this way!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Digi! I'm a big fan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But… why?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Um. I mean. Thank you so kindly…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I don't really have any new publications to distribute, but If you'd like to, I'd love to chat with you about Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As these interactions continue, Agnes Digital gradually grows more comfortable talking with her fans.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All righty! Here's the autograph and message, sent to your @!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll also throw in a copy of "Bottle Passed from Turf to Dirt" as a little extra. I had leftover stock, so I figured I'd take the Fan Fest as an opporunity to share it…

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, thank you! I'm so glad I came today! I like you more and more every second!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: To think even a shoddy excuse for an oshi like me has fans watching…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I g-guess so. I'm always on the other side of the table, which is why…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait, I get it! I understand the fan's feelings far better than the feelings of those who receive their praise!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So if I put myself in their shoes, it's easy to imagine the responses they want to hear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Agnes Digital has a firm hold on what it takes to make her fans happy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's keep this up! I don't want anyone leaving disappointed because there wasn't enough time for their turn.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: In fact, when it comes to my fans, I don't know the meaning of the word "disappoint"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Agnes Digital spends the whole day working herself ragged for her fans.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hmmm. When you really look at it, there's a lot of room for improvement at this event.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: With just a few adjustments, we could make things better for both the fans and the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nyehehe. Hey… Once the autograph session is over, can we go around and make some quick edits?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Just gimme your permission, and I'll show you exactly how passionate a promoter I can be.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! I knew you'd get it. You understand how the fans feel! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, as soon as the autograph event is over, Agnes Digital starts taking control of things.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let's see… Why don't we make a separate area for this game? That way, there's no danger of anyone getting accidentally hit and injured.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Once the game is finished, we should make some time for photos. I know I'd want a pic for my lock screen if it was me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the Fan Fest improves right before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Today was truly a spectacular success—almost as if there was some figure working in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That was Agnes Digital. Apparently, she followed all of the rules to a T and was still able to incorporate so much detail…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Digital! Not half bad! We really killed it today, thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's right! Those cute little extras you suggested for the cafe and food stalls were a huge hit! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It was totally buono! Thank you, Digital! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: H-h-huuuh? You're all too kind… I just did what I could…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's Digital for ya! She made so many changes, yet we didn't have a single problem!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Today, Digital is the real hero! Let's toss her in the air! Everyone, get in formation!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait, what's going on?! Everyone? All at once?!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Hip, hip, hooray!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat is happening heeeeere?! Are you all goddesseees?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Agnes Digital has become a runner with fans inside of Tracen Academy as well.
